premise: Three spacecraft want the one landing pad at once — the supply pod, the lander and the huge ship — and politely take turns, each landing and moving aside for the next.
inspiration: The Ukrainian folk tale 'The Mitten', where animal after animal squeezes into one mitten until it bursts, turned: nobody squeezes — they take turns.

en-US.title: One Pad, Three Landings
en-US.text: [excited] It was the busiest day the landing pad had ever seen. Three spacecraft were coming in, and there was only one pad! First came the {supply-pod:enter} {supply-pod:go to pad} supply pod, small and quick. {sfx:thud} Thump! {supply-pod:wobble} {supply-pod:live} It opened up to unload its crates, then hopped aside {supply-pod:go to plain} to make room. Next came the {lander:enter} {lander:go to pad} lander, on its four round feet. {canvas:dust 0.5 6s} {lander:live} It opened its hatch for a moment, then shuffled aside {lander:go to plain} too. [short pause] And last of all, the huge {ship:enter} {ship:go to pad} ship came down, slow and gentle, onto the empty pad. [playfully] Nobody bumped. {supply-pod:shake 0.3} Nobody squeezed. {ship:pulse} Everybody took turns. {lander:pulse} {ship:live} The ship lowered its crew elevator to say thank you. [happily] And for one day, the Moon had the tidiest landing pad in space. {all:face happy} {all:hop}

es-ES.title: Una plataforma, tres aterrizajes
es-ES.text: [excited] Era el día de más trabajo de la plataforma de aterrizaje. Llegaban tres naves, ¡y solo había una plataforma! Primero llegó la {supply-pod:enter} {supply-pod:go to pad} cápsula de carga, pequeña y rápida. {sfx:thud} ¡Pum! {supply-pod:wobble} {supply-pod:live} Se abrió para descargar sus cajas, y luego se apartó de un saltito {supply-pod:go to plain} para dejar sitio. Después llegó el {lander:enter} {lander:go to pad} módulo lunar, sobre sus cuatro patas redondas. {canvas:dust 0.5 6s} {lander:live} Abrió la escotilla un momento, y después se apartó {lander:go to plain} también. [short pause] Y por último, la enorme {ship:enter} {ship:go to pad} nave bajó, despacio y suave, hasta la plataforma vacía. [playfully] Nadie chocó. {supply-pod:shake 0.3} Nadie se apretujó. {ship:pulse} Todos esperaron su turno. {lander:pulse} {ship:live} La nave bajó su ascensor para dar las gracias. [happily] Y durante un día, la Luna tuvo la plataforma más ordenada del espacio. {all:face happy} {all:hop}
